leadText:
Pokémon All-Stars is a collection of DVDs published by VIZ Media and released between June 6, 2006 and April 20, 2009. With a total of 20 volumes, each DVD includes three episodes of that mainly focus on one specific Pokémon. All volumes were released two at a time, and later bundled in box sets of ten. The first box set was released on July 1, 2007, and the second on August 25, 2009.

This series of DVDs started as a way to celebrate Pokémon's . It was succeeded by Pokémon Elements.
